answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils by making influence path-dependent. Each key must keep a lantern lit with original, peer-attested work that stays visible for one full epoch; voting weight accrues only while that light stays continuous. Mid-epoch, a zephyr assigns a unique short-lived nonce puzzle to that exact key—farmed clones cannot answer every breeze at once. When detectors find copied wording or shared funders, they paint an umber mark that freezes new keys in the cluster until the bond is burned, so identity floods stall instead of scaling votes.
